        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_adapter_status value = 4 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_adapter_status value = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_probation_fact_red_code value = 4101 }
    }
}
